pageProps.content: ## Review A massive market located in the heart of Melbourne. With over `140 years` of history, it's home to more than 600 small vendors under one roof. From souvenirs to fresh produce to everyday essentials, it felt like you could find just about anything. Just browsing took quite a bit of time. ```adcard ``` I was caught off guard at the vegetable section. Every single vegetable was enormous. Price-wise, it was roughly on par with back home. One tip: don't buy Australian strawberries. Despite their looks, they just don't taste good. It's a fun place with plenty to see and eat, but if you're planning to visit Sydney, there's probably no need to buy things here. Our tour guide mentioned that due to distribution channels, Sydney tends to be cheaper. ## Pictures
